properties.query: ThreatIntelIndicators | where SourceSystem == "AbuseIPDB" | summarize LastIngest = max(TimeGenerated), IndicatorCount = count() | extend HoursSinceRefresh = round(todouble(datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastIngest)) / 60.0, 1) | where HoursSinceRefresh > 36 | extend TimeGenerated = now() | project TimeGenerated, LastIngest, HoursSinceRefresh, IndicatorCount
properties.description: The AbuseIPDB indicator feed has not refreshed in over 36 hours. Two TI-matching rules join SigninLogs and AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs against ThreatIntelIndicators, so a stalled feed means those detections are silently running against expiring indicators. Outcome-based on purpose: it fires whether the cause is a failed playbook run, a revoked Key Vault secret, an exhausted AbuseIPDB quota, or a missing role assignment. LIMITATION: queryPeriod caps at 14 days, so if the feed dies for longer than that the summarize returns no rows and this rule goes quiet - treat prolonged silence from it as suspicious rather than healthy.
